items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Emotional (Heart).

children.label: Repressed center
children.value: Emotional: the paradox of type 3, often disconnected from their authentic feelings in favor of functioning.

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Used both inward and outward.

items.label: Core issue
items.value: The need for value and identity through achievement and the admiration of others.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, ego pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoiding failure at all costs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Deceit: self-deception, identifying with an image of success to mask an inner emptiness.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Vanity: investing energy in a flattering facade and adapting to social expectations.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Identification: becoming the role, function, or projected image in order to succeed.

items.label: Ego pride
items.value: I succeed, I am effective.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being worthless, without intrinsic value apart from their accomplishments.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Feeling valuable, admired and accepted.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Security / Accumulation (workaholic): security through material success and hard work; often the most modest of the 3s.

children.label: Social
children.value: Prestige: shining and being recognized as the best within the group/society.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Masculinity-Femininity / Attractiveness (the pearl): success through appeal, the ideal partner, supporting the other's success.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Assertive (ego-expansive): approaches people by taking center stage and setting the pace of the action.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Competency: sets feelings aside to stay effective and solution-oriented.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 2 (more sociable and encouraging) and wing 4 (more serious, introspective, style-oriented).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 6: cooperative, loyal, committed to the common good, accepts their vulnerabilities.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 9: apathetic, disengaged, pointless routines, becomes robotic under pressure.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Hope, Holy Law, Holy Harmony: the universe unfolds according to a harmonious order, one is not alone in the doing.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Truthfulness / Authenticity: being oneself without a mask, beyond performance.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Personal essence (the pearl): being a real person whose action flows from Being.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Separate doer: believing one must do everything oneself in order to exist.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner Little 6: fearful, seeking support, which performance tries to reassure.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Propaganda / Self-promotion: presenting facts and oneself in the best light to motivate and convince.

items.label: Communication miscommunication
items.value: Motivation-Bragging: enthusiasm can be perceived as insincerity or arrogance.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Basing their worth on successes, workaholism, fleeing moments of inactivity/emptiness.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Slowing down, welcoming emotions, practicing non-doing, admitting their failures.

items.label: Frequent mix-ups
items.value: 7 (energy); 1 (efficiency). Difference: 7 flees pain, 3 aims for results; 1 follows principles, 3 follows goals.

children.label: In love
children.value: Devoted and effective; may sacrifice intimacy for status/career; fears not being loved if they aren't perfect.

children.label: At work
children.value: A leader and motivator, results-oriented; can become impatient with those judged to be slow.

levels.text: Authentic: shines naturally, acts truly, inspires effortlessly.
Role model: effective and humble, success in service of reality.
Self-assured: performs without betraying themselves, grounded in their values.
Competitor: seeks to win, optimizes image, compares.
Image-conscious pragmatist: adapts everything to the outcome and to others' perceptions.
Self-promoting narcissist: oversells, puts on a show, depends on approval.
Dishonest opportunist: manipulates appearances, bypasses ethics.
Malicious deceiver: lies, exploits others, cynicism.
Vindictive psychopath: coldness, exploitation, destruction to preserve the ego.

items.label: Awareness
items.value: Moving from doing mode to being mode: worth is intrinsic and does not depend on achievements.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: Strongly aligned with ORANGE: success, strategy, efficiency, materialism.

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A peacock: spreads its feathers to impress, forgetting that its beauty does not depend on others' gaze.
